extras: Unofficial project; requires DeepSeek API key and payment; API key stored in plain text in .obsidian/plugins/deepseek-chat/data.json.
intentEvidence: Every capability from DeepSeek's official Build a Chatbot guide is built in
problem: Users need a way to leverage advanced AI capabilities, such as web search and document analysis, directly within their local Obsidian vault without leaving the application.

relations.evidence: Chat with DeepSeek in an Obsidian sidebar using your own API key.

summary: DeepSeek Chat allows users to interact with the DeepSeek AI model within an Obsidian sidebar using a personal API key, supporting advanced features like web search and file analysis.
